sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "affected_region"."Storm_ID" AS e, AVG("affected_region"."Number_city_affected") AS m1 FROM "affected_region" GROUP BY "affected_region"."Storm_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
quantities: affected_region.cities affected by storm in region
why: average of cities affected by storm in region per storm (by Storm_ID)
gap to the all average of average of cities affected by storm in region (all level)
